units: <cite ref="Gittin 57a:15">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ל׳ ביצה</he> the white of an egg.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:1">Neg. IV, 1</cite> <he>מראה ל׳</he> the white color (of leprosy).
<cite ref="Niddah 31a">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>הל׳</he> the white substance (semen virile).
<cite ref="Niddah 31a:27">Ib.</cite> <he>הל׳ שבעין</he> the white of the eye; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לוֹבְנִים</he>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:10:2">Koh. R. to V, 10</cite> <he>לובן שממנו הל׳</he> the white (semen) out of which are formed the white substances of the embryonic body.

senses.gloss: (לָבַן I) the mass of clay for bricks.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 48:13">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII</cite> <he>בין ל׳ הלבנים</he> in the clay stamped for bricks.
